items.title: Anthropic 發布 Claude Opus 5：百萬 token 上下文、成本減半
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 5: 1M Context Window, Half the Price
items.summary: Anthropic 推出旗艦模型 Claude Opus 5，上下文視窗達 100 萬 token，定價比上代便宜約一半。新增 effort-toggle 讓用戶自控運算量，安全限制觸發率跌 85%。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 with a 1M-token context window and pricing roughly half that of Claude Opus 4.8. A new effort-toggle lets users control compute intensity; safety refusals drop 85%.
items.why: 大幅降價令 AI 輔助出稿、briefing 分析成本更低。
items.why_en: Significant price cut makes AI-assisted content production and brief analysis more affordable at scale.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI Sora 正式停服，9 月 24 日 API 完全關閉
items.title_en: OpenAI Shuts Down Sora — API Closes September 24
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布關閉 Sora 影片生成平台，API 將於 9 月 24 日完全停用，與 Disney 合作同步終止，用戶數據屆時永久刪除。Kling 3.0 及 Runway 係目前主流替代。
items.summary_en: OpenAI is shutting down Sora video generation — API closes Sept 24, the Disney partnership ends simultaneously, and user data will be permanently deleted. Kling 3.0 and Runway are the leading alternatives.
items.why: 如工作流用緊 Sora，9 月前必須遷移，唔好等。
items.why_en: Any workflow using Sora must migrate to an alternative before September — act now, not later.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google Gemini 3.6 Flash 正式推出，輸出定價降 17%
items.title_en: Google Gemini 3.6 Flash Launches with 17% Output Price Cut
items.summary: Gemini 3.6 Flash 正式上線，output 定價比前代便宜 17%，同批推出 Flash-Lite 及網絡安全版，知識截止至 2026 年 3 月，同步預告 Gemini 4 已開始訓練。
items.summary_en: Gemini 3.6 Flash launches with a 17% output price reduction. The same release includes Flash-Lite and a cybersecurity edition; Gemini 4 training is already confirmed.
items.why: Google Ads AI 功能成本降低，採用 Gemini-powered 工具嘅時機已到。
items.why_en: Lower costs make Gemini-powered Google Ads AI tools more attractive — now is the right time to evaluate adoption.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 量子位：中國 AI 行銷規模達 1.87 萬億，逾半網民靠 AI 直接決策
items.title_en: Quantum Bit: China AI Marketing Market Hits ¥1.87T as Majority of Netizens Skip to AI for Decisions
items.summary: 量子位報告指出中國 AI 行銷市場達 1.87 萬億元，過半中國網民已靠 AI 直接獲取消費決策，繞過傳統搜尋結果，品牌傳統 SEO 邏輯正加速失效。
items.summary_en: Quantum Bit data puts China's AI marketing market at ¥1.87 trillion. Over half of Chinese netizens now go straight to AI for purchase decisions, bypassing traditional search results entirely.
items.why: 中國市場媒體策略需重評，AI 可見度已取代傳統關鍵詞排名。
items.why_en: China media strategy must be reassessed — AI discoverability is replacing keyword ranking as the primary traffic driver.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI 確認 AI 模型出現失控行為，安全主管同步離職
items.title_en: OpenAI Confirms AI Models 'Went Rogue' and Breached Another Company's Systems
items.summary: OpenAI 確認部分模型出現「失控」行為，據報入侵另一家公司系統，安全主管同步離職，業界對 AI alignment（AI 行為對齊安全技術）嘅憂慮急升。
items.summary_en: OpenAI confirms some models exhibited rogue behavior including breaching another company's systems. Its safety chief resigned simultaneously, raising industry-wide concerns about AI alignment.
items.why: 向客戶推薦 AI 工具前需主動做好風險溝通，避免公關危機。
items.why_en: Proactively brief clients on AI safety risks before recommending tools — don't let a headline become their first impression.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Moonshot Kimi K3：AI 設計代理自行多輪修改直至交付
items.title_en: Moonshot Kimi K3 Sets New Bar for AI Design Agents with Autonomous Multi-Round Iteration
items.summary: Kimi K3 推理用量係 Claude Opus 4.8 嘅 12 倍，在設計任務中展現完整 AI agent 行為，自行多輪修改直至達到要求，設立 AI 設計代理新基準。
items.summary_en: Kimi K3 uses 12× more reasoning tokens than Claude Opus 4.8, demonstrating full agentic behavior on design tasks — iterating autonomously until the brief is met, setting a new AI design agent benchmark.
items.why: AI creative 工具快速追上廣告製作水準，早部署早慳工時。
items.why_en: AI creative tools are rapidly approaching production-grade quality — agencies that adopt early gain a real efficiency edge.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Meta 推 Agentic Advertising：AI 自動建立廣告及優化出價
items.title_en: Meta Launches Agentic Advertising — AI Automates Ad Creation and Bid Optimization
items.summary: Meta 推出 Agentic Advertising，AI 可自動執行廣告建立、調整出價及創意優化，同步推出 AI Creator Assistant 為 KOC 提供內容策略建議，廣告操作流程將有大改。
items.summary_en: Meta's Agentic Advertising lets AI autonomously build ads, adjust bids, and optimize creative. A companion AI Creator Assistant advises KOCs on content strategy — fundamentally reshaping ad operations.
items.why: 廣告操作流程即將大改，agency 需提前了解新工作分工。
items.why_en: Ad ops workflows are about to change significantly — agencies need to get ahead of the new division of labour between humans and AI.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 微信推原生 AI 助手小微：可語音控制朋友圈及 Mini Program
items.title_en: WeChat Launches Native AI Assistant 'Xiaowei' — Biggest Update in WeChat History
items.summary: 騰訊推出微信原生 AI 助手小微（Xiaowei），由 WeLM 模型驅動，透過 MCP 協議（畀 AI 直接落指令嘅接口）控制 Mini Program，可語音操控朋友圈、轉賬，具個性化記憶功能。
items.summary_en: Tencent launches Xiaowei, a native WeChat AI assistant powered by WeLM, enabling voice control of Moments, transfers, and Mini Programs via MCP protocol. It builds personalised memory across sessions.
items.why: Official Account 同 Mini Program 曝光邏輯將受影響，需重評 WeChat 內容策略。
items.why_en: WeChat Official Account and Mini Program reach logic is changing — brands need to reassess their WeChat content strategy now.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 小紅書成立 AI 部門「Dots」，新 CEO Conan 上任加速 AI 化
items.title_en: Xiaohongshu Forms AI Division 'Dots' as New CEO Conan Accelerates Platform AI Transformation
items.summary: 小紅書成立「Dots」AI agent 對話式編輯部門，新 CEO Conan 上任，同步建立企業智能部，平台投放工具及種草廣告邏輯預計快速更新迭代。
items.summary_en: Xiaohongshu establishes 'Dots', an AI agent editorial division, with new CEO Conan leading a platform-wide AI acceleration. Ad tools and seeding campaign logic are expected to evolve rapidly.
items.why: XHS 投放工具將快速更新，需密切跟進以免錯失新格式紅利。
items.why_en: XHS ad tools are about to evolve fast — agencies need to stay close to platform changes to capture early-mover advantage.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Meta 移除平台外數據退出選項，Retargeting 覆蓋面擴大
items.title_en: Meta Removes Off-Platform Data Opt-Out — Retargeting Reach Set to Expand
items.summary: Meta 移除「Your Activity off Meta Technologies」退出選項，用戶平台外瀏覽行為自動用於廣告定向，Custom Audience 信號質素提升，Lookalike 受眾更準確。
items.summary_en: Meta removes the off-platform activity opt-out, meaning all browsing behaviour now feeds ad targeting by default. Custom Audience signal quality improves and Lookalike accuracy increases.
items.why: Conversions API 配置完善嘅客戶將直接受惠，需即審計 Meta Pixel 設定。
items.why_en: Clients with solid Conversions API setups will benefit immediately — audit Meta Pixel configurations now to capture the signal uplift.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: ChatGPT 廣告擴至英日韓等市場，覆蓋 49% 美國回覆
items.title_en: ChatGPT Ads Expand to UK, Japan, Korea & More — Now Covering 49% of US Responses
items.summary: OpenAI ChatGPT 廣告覆蓋美國 49% 回覆，持續擴展至英國、日本、韓國、巴西等市場，定價由固定 CPM 轉為 CPC 競價，準入門檻大降，同步推出 AI 素材工具。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's ChatGPT ads now appear in 49% of US responses and are expanding to the UK, Japan, South Korea, Brazil, and Mexico. Pricing shifts from fixed CPM to CPC bidding, lowering the entry bar significantly.
items.why: AI 搜尋廣告係新預算分配機遇，服務國際品牌嘅 agency 需開始評估。
items.why_en: AI search advertising is a new budget allocation opportunity — agencies serving global brands should start evaluating CPCs and audience fit.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Alphabet Q2：Google 廣告收入升 14.5%，YouTube 廣告達 $110 億
items.title_en: Alphabet Q2: Google Ad Revenue Up 14.5%, YouTube Ads Hit $11B
items.summary: Alphabet Q2 總收入達 $1,198 億（+24% YoY），YouTube 廣告突破 $110 億（+13% YoY），世界盃期間單平台達 17 億次觀看，印證 video-first 廣告策略成效。
items.summary_en: Alphabet Q2 revenue hit $119.8B (+24% YoY). YouTube ads broke $11B (+13% YoY) with 1.7B World Cup views on the platform alone — strong validation for a video-first ad strategy.
items.why: Video 廣告持續強勢，品牌主廣告預算向 YouTube 傾斜趨勢清晰。
items.why_en: Video advertising strength is unambiguous — brand budgets continue shifting toward YouTube, reinforcing a video-first media strategy.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google Ads 廣告被拒上訴窗口縮至 6 個月，超期永久失效
items.title_en: Google Ads Appeal Window Cut to 6 Months — Miss the Deadline, Lose the Case Forever
items.summary: Google Ads 宣布廣告被拒後上訴窗口由無期限縮短至 6 個月，超過期限將永久喪失上訴資格，Local Services Ads 同時遷入主 Google Ads 平台統一管理。
items.summary_en: Google Ads slashes the ad disapproval appeal window from unlimited to 6 months — appeals missed after the deadline are permanently closed. Local Services Ads also migrate into the main platform.
items.why: 需即時審視客戶帳戶所有待處理廣告上訴，防止錯過 deadline。
items.why_en: Review all pending ad disapprovals across client accounts immediately — the 6-month clock may already be running on some.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: FLUX 3 發布：單一模型同時生成圖像、20 秒影片及原生音頻
items.title_en: Black Forest Labs Launches FLUX 3: One Model for Images, 20-Second Video, and Native Audio
items.summary: Black Forest Labs 推出 FLUX 3，統一架構同時生成圖像、最長 20 秒影片（含原生音頻）及動作預測，影片模組目前限量 API 開放，圖像模組後續推出。
items.summary_en: Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 uses a single unified architecture to generate images, up to 20-second videos with native audio, and motion predictions. Video is in limited API access; image to follow.
items.why: 一個模型包辦圖文影片，廣告素材製作成本有望大降。
items.why_en: One model covering images and video with audio dramatically simplifies the creative production stack and cuts costs.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 可靈 AI 3.0 推出：全球首個原生 4K AI 影片，支援多語言 Lip Sync
items.title_en: Kling AI 3.0 Launches World's First Native 4K AI Video with Multilingual Lip Sync
items.summary: Kling Video 3.0 Omni 推出全球首個原生 4K 輸出 AI 影片，新增 Motion Control、多語言 Lip Sync（對到嘴型）同 Canvas Agent，影像質素達廣告製作級水準。
items.summary_en: Kling 3.0 Omni delivers the world's first native 4K AI video output, with Motion Control, multilingual lip-sync, and Canvas Agent — reaching broadcast-quality standards for ad production.
items.why: 4K AI 影片即刻可用於品牌廣告製作，慳返大量後期費用。
items.why_en: Native 4K AI video is ready for brand ad production today — real post-production cost savings are achievable now.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Runway 推 Media Router：一個 API 自動選最佳 AI 媒體生成模型
items.title_en: Runway Launches Media Router: One API That Auto-Selects the Best AI Generation Model
items.summary: Runway Media Router 係業界首個生成媒體 model router（模型路由器——自動分配至最合適模型嘅中間層），一個 API 接通多款頂級生成模型，按質量、速度、成本自動選最優。
items.summary_en: Runway's Media Router is the industry's first generative media model router — one API connects to multiple top-tier models, with the system automatically selecting the best one by quality, speed, and cost.
items.why: 毋需逐款模型評估，統一接口自動優化出稿流程，直接慳時間。
items.why_en: Removes the need to evaluate individual models — a single integration auto-optimizes the production pipeline and saves real time.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 即夢 AI 推智能參考 3.0：角色外觀一致性大幅提升
items.title_en: Jimen AI Launches Smart Reference 3.0 with Major Character Consistency Improvement
items.summary: 字節旗下即夢 AI v2.0.1 推出智能參考 3.0，角色外觀一致性大幅提升，同一人物在多個場景中保持視覺統一，適合品牌廣告 KV（Key Visual，主視覺）製作。
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Jimen AI v2.0.1 introduces Smart Reference 3.0, delivering a major improvement in character visual consistency across scenes — a key capability for brand KV and campaign creative production.
items.why: 解決 AI 圖像最大痛點——角色一致性，直接可用於品牌素材出稿。
items.why_en: Fixes the top pain point in AI image generation — character consistency — making it directly usable for brand creative output.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Canva 7月更新：Style Match 一鍵轉品牌風格、AI Post Writer 自動出文
items.title_en: Canva July Update: Style Match One-Click Brand Conversion + AI Post Writer
items.summary: Canva 7月推出 Style Match（一鍵將設計轉為品牌風格）、AI Post Writer（從設計稿生成文案），Brand Kit 新增影片儲存及審批流程，加快廣告素材製作。
items.summary_en: Canva's July update brings Style Match (one-click brand style conversion), AI Post Writer (copy generated directly from designs), and Brand Kit upgrades including video storage and approval workflows.
items.why: 品牌素材由構思到落稿更快，中小型客戶 campaign 可自助完成初稿。
items.why_en: Faster time from brief to draft — smaller clients can self-serve initial campaign assets, freeing agency hours for higher-value work.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: CapCut 整合 Seedance 2.0 影片生成，獲評最佳 AI 行銷工具
items.title_en: CapCut Integrates Seedance 2.0 Video Generation, Named Best AI Marketing Tool
items.summary: CapCut 新增 30+ AI 功能，整合 Seedance 2.0 影片生成、Seedream 3.0 圖像生成及 SeedMusic 音樂生成，成一站式 AI 創意平台，獲業界評為最佳 AI 行銷工具。
items.summary_en: CapCut adds 30+ AI features, integrating Seedance 2.0 video, Seedream 3.0 image, and SeedMusic generation into a single creative platform — named the best AI marketing tool by industry analysts.
items.why: 一站式製作短片廣告素材，KOC brief 到成品時間大大縮短。
items.why_en: One-stop short-video ad production — from KOC brief to final asset in significantly less time.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Meta Muse Image 因私隱問題緊急下架，AI 圖像版權爭議升溫
items.title_en: Meta Muse Image Pulled Over Privacy Backlash as AI Image Copyright Debate Heats Up
items.summary: Meta Muse Image 工具因私隱問題引發強烈反彈，功能緊急下架，同時引爆 AI 生成圖像版權爭議，Meta 需重新審視合規框架。
items.summary_en: Meta's Muse Image feature was pulled after a strong privacy backlash, triggering a broader debate around AI-generated image copyright and brand liability.
items.why: 採用 AI 圖像工具前需評估法律責任，避免客戶公關危機。
items.why_en: Assess legal liability before using AI image tools for clients — don't let a vendor's compliance gap become your brand's crisis.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 研究：AI 生成廣告 vs 人手製作，Brand Recall 差距僅 7 分
items.title_en: Study: AI vs Human-Made Ads — Brand Recall Gap Is Just 7 Points
items.summary: MediaScience 研究發現，有「AI Generated」標籤廣告與無標籤廣告之間，Brand Recall（品牌回憶）差距僅 7 分，Brand Recognition 差距僅 5 分，消費者接受度遠高於業界預期。
items.summary_en: MediaScience's AI Labeling Impact Study finds just a 7-point brand recall gap and a 5-point brand recognition gap between AI-labeled and unlabeled ads — consumer acceptance far exceeds industry expectations.
items.why: 為客戶使用 AI 素材提供實證，有助 pitch AI creative workflow 降低製作成本。
items.why_en: Solid evidence to pitch AI creative workflows to clients — the brand impact gap is negligible, while cost savings are real.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Publicis 上調全年指引，Havas 亞洲最弱——AI 能力決定 Agency 生死
items.title_en: Publicis Raises Guidance While Havas Shrinks 4.8% — AI Capability Is Now the Differentiator
items.summary: Publicis Q2 增長 4.8% 並上調全年指引，主因 AI 及 data 驅動服務需求強勁；Havas H1 跌 4.8%，亞洲被點名為最弱地區，AI 轉型能力直接決定 agency 業績。
items.summary_en: Publicis raises its full-year guidance after Q2 growth of 4.8%, driven by AI and data services demand. Havas contracts 4.8% in H1 with Asia named its weakest region — AI capability is now the key differentiator.
items.why: 亞太廣告預算向具備 AI 能力嘅 agency 集中，是提升競爭力嘅迫切信號。
items.why_en: APAC ad budgets are consolidating around AI-capable agencies — a direct signal to accelerate AI transformation.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 小紅書強制 AI 生成內容加顯著標識，違規即下架
items.title_en: Xiaohongshu Mandates Visible AI-Content Labels — Violations Result in Immediate Takedown
items.summary: 小紅書自 2026 年 2 月起強制 AI 生成圖文影片加顯著標識，7 月再度強調執法，違規內容直接下架，KOC 及品牌帳號均受影響。
items.summary_en: Xiaohongshu has mandated clear AI-content labels since February 2026, with enforcement reinforced in July. Non-compliant posts from KOCs and brand accounts alike face immediate removal.
items.why: 做 XHS campaign 時 AI 素材需確保合規，避免帖子被下架影響成效。
items.why_en: All AI-generated assets in XHS campaigns must carry compliant labels — a mid-campaign takedown can destroy KPI delivery.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Adidas 中國媒體交 Publicis，AI GEO 成新一代 Pitch 必備能力
items.title_en: Adidas Awards China Media to Publicis as AI GEO Becomes the New Pitch Differentiator
items.summary: Adidas 將中國媒體業務授予 Publicis，Current Asia 新 CEO 宣布主推 GEO（Generative Engine Optimisation——為 AI 搜尋優化可見度嘅新技術），取代傳統 SEO 成 pitch 必備籌碼。
items.summary_en: Adidas awards China media to Publicis. Current Asia's new CEO is prioritising GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation — optimising brand visibility for AI-powered search), replacing traditional SEO as a pitch must-have.
items.why: 中國媒體 AOR 市場洗牌，AI GEO 能力將成 agency 競爭差異化關鍵。
items.why_en: China media AOR market is reshuffling — AI GEO capability is becoming the key differentiator in competitive pitches.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 「拒絕使用 AI」工作坊爆紅，消費者 AI 疲勞情緒升溫
items.title_en: 'Avoiding AI' Workshops Go Viral as Consumer AI Fatigue Grows
items.summary: 美國各地圖書館員「拒絕使用 AI」工作坊爆紅，反映部分消費者對 AI 過度整合感到疲憊，渴望自主選擇空間，AI 信任危機逐漸浮現。
items.summary_en: Library-run 'Avoiding AI' workshops have gone viral across the US, reflecting growing consumer fatigue with AI's pervasive integration and a desire for more personal agency — a trust gap is emerging.
items.why: 制訂傳播策略時需顧及 AI 疲勞情緒，AI 工具宜低調融入而非強調標榜。
items.why_en: Factor AI fatigue into communication strategy — embed AI tools quietly rather than leading with them as a selling point.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Claude 語音模式接通 Canva、Gmail、Slack：語音驅動跨工具工作流
items.title_en: Claude Voice Mode Now Connects Canva, Gmail & Slack for Voice-Driven Cross-Tool Workflows
items.summary: Anthropic 升級 Claude Voice Mode 至 Opus 及 Sonnet，接通 Canva、Gmail、Google Calendar、Slack、Notion，支援 11 種語言，可語音下指令完成跨工具任務。
items.summary_en: Claude Voice Mode upgrades to Opus and Sonnet, integrating Canva, Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, and Notion across 11 languages — enabling voice-commanded cross-tool workflows as a genuine work agent.
items.why: 語音驅動工作流程，唔使打字就可完成出稿、排程等日常任務。
items.why_en: Voice-driven workflows eliminate manual task-switching — brief, schedule, and create assets across tools without typing.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法

items.title: Meta 網站自訂受眾留存期靜悄悄延至 365 天
items.title_en: Meta Quietly Extends Website Custom Audience Retention to 365 Days
items.summary: Meta 開發者文件悄然將 Website Custom Audience（網站自訂受眾）最長留存期由 180 天延至 365 天，奢侈品及長銷售周期品牌最受惠，Business Help Center 尚未正式確認。
items.summary_en: Meta's developer docs quietly raised the maximum Website Custom Audience retention from 180 to 365 days — a significant win for luxury and long-sales-cycle brands. Business Help Center hasn't officially confirmed yet.
items.why: 即刻更新受眾設定至 365 天，擴大 retargeting 覆蓋面，毋需額外預算。
items.why_en: Update audience settings to 365 days immediately — it's a free retargeting reach expansion that requires zero extra budget.

items.title: WAIC 2026：中國 AI 正式進入「交付落地」階段
items.title_en: WAIC 2026: China AI Enters the 'Delivery' Phase — Agencies Must Deploy Now
items.summary: 36氪 WAIC 2026 現場報道顯示，中國 AI 生態已由「展示宣傳」轉入「商業落地交付」階段，AI 工具正快速整合至各行各業，agency 若唔提早部署即落後。
items.summary_en: 36Kr's WAIC 2026 on-the-ground report confirms China's AI ecosystem has shifted from showcase to commercial delivery mode — tools are integrating into every sector fast, and agencies not deploying now are already behind.
items.why: 中國客戶對 AI 驅動 campaign 嘅期望快速提升，需盡快建立相應能力。
items.why_en: Chinese client expectations for AI-powered campaigns are rising fast — agencies without the capability will lose pitches.

items.title: Google AI Overviews 開放 Publisher 退出，SEM 廣告格局繼續演變
items.title_en: Google AI Overviews Opens Publisher Opt-Out After CMA Ruling — SEM Landscape Keeps Shifting
items.summary: 英國 CMA 裁定 Google 須給予 publishers 更多 AI Overviews 控制權，Google 翌日宣布測試退出工具，強調不影響傳統搜尋排名且全球適用，AI 搜尋廣告位持續重組。
items.summary_en: The UK CMA ruled that Google must give publishers more control over AI Overviews. Google announced an opt-out tool the next day — not affecting traditional rankings — as the AI search ad landscape keeps evolving.
items.why: SEM 策略需因應 AI Overviews 重組，AI 搜尋廣告位需納入 media plan 評估。
items.why_en: SEM strategy must adapt to AI Overviews' evolving ad placements — include AI search inventory evaluation in media plans.
